Bulgaria
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Sofia, Bulgaria.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
For the holder of a travel certificate in transit YES
Citizens of the Republic of Bulgaria are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.At the entrance to the Republic of Bulgaria, it is necessary to buy a vignette, which for passenger cars is 13 BGN for 7 days, 27 BGN for 1 month, 48 BGN for three months and 87 BGN for 1 year. Weekend vignette (Friday from 12:00 p.m. - Sunday until 11:59 p.m.) price BGN 9.
